title: Build Your Own CRM With AI: Replace Salesforce for $0/Month in Per-Seat Fees
summary: Salesforce costs $25-$300/seat/month. Build a custom CRM with AI — contacts, pipeline, notes, automations — with zero per-seat fees and full ownership.
body_markdown: Three things Salesforce genuinely does better: AppExchange ecosystem integrations (thousands of prebuilt connectors), enterprise compliance certifications (FedRAMP, HIPAA-eligible storage), and native mobile apps with offline mode. If your contracts require Salesforce certifications by name, or you depend on specific AppExchange apps with no API, custom builds don't replicate that easily. For most teams under 50 people, none of these apply.
